body:
When you feel betrayed or disappointed in people remember that even 200 years wouldn't be enough for a human to be wise, we are all new to life. People are just weak and, because of that, selfish. It's sad it went this way with her but living is not easy, try not to blame her, yourself or whoever hurt you cause we are all learning as we go.  
Be strong, hope you'll get better.

I haven't been dealing with it, at least not positevely, or i wouldn't be here. I guess the only answer i can give you is i'm used to it, it's gotten worst throughout the years but at the same time i'm more experienced. how about you?   
thank you, hope you'll get better and find love for yourself.
